## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website, UK audience. No send time given.

### Checks

**Claims**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Good tea, guaranteed." | Not allowed. Policy §3 bans guarantees, and we have no such offer. |
| "Risk-free." | Not allowed. Same rule. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list (certificate renewed 2026). OK. |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" | Policy says "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol". Fine for tins. OK as written. |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list. OK. |

**Regulated claims:** "Guaranteed" and "risk-free" are also consumer-law risks, since they imply a refund or return promise we don't offer. Nothing on health, environment, children or prices beyond the allowed delivery line.

**House style:** No banned words. Voice is fairly warm and plain. "Good tea, guaranteed." is a slogan-style opener, a mild AI tell, and goes away with the fix.

**Disclosure:** Own-site hero copy, no partnership, affiliate or AI content. Nothing needed.

### Fixed (suggested rewrite)
> Good tea, certified organic by the Soil Association and packed by hand in Bristol. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

Changes: removed "guaranteed" and "risk-free"; kept all four proven claims word for word in substance.

### Needs a decision
- Approve the rewrite above. If you want a returns or refund promise in the hero, it must first be written into the policy as a real offer.

### Approver
Sam (marketing lead). Nothing has been approved, so it should not be published yet. Once Sam says yes to the exact rewritten text, record the approval and retry the publish.
